criteria: Existing independently developed API, not created for V4
Creates events with title, start and end
HTTP POST with JSON requests and JSON responses
Meaningful schema or validation differences from A/B
Basic request does not require changing frozen V4 runtime or vocabulary
operational_interpretation: Inspect native contracts, not V4 invocation success. Existing public repo commits/releases must predate this selection. No synthetic API, proxy, required extra fields, mandatory unsupported authentication, nested-only response ID, unsupported timestamp conversion or unsupported method may be concealed. Unknowns remain unknown until native validation.
selection_rule: Screen at least three existing candidates if accessible. Select a plausible eligible candidate from native contracts, favoring minimal local setup and readable original storage. Freeze choice/source/dependencies before native checks. If selected candidate fails any criterion, stop and preserve failure; no replacement in this task.
